messages:
lina: Heads-up: prepping airgap HSM connector + strict netpols for next private deploy. Main goals: no outbound except kms-proxy, signed audit envelopes, and minimal provisioner RBAC. Thoughts?

omar: Sounds good. For RBAC, create a new ClusterRole 'provisioner-min' and bind in canary ns only. Avoid patching live role.

cleo: HSM connector note: current 0.9.1 listens on 0.0.0.0 by default. Make sure we force bind to localhost and drop the embedded SSH server. We'll block until 0.9.4.

lina: Agree. Sequence: 1) push connector v0.9.4 to canary 2) deploy kms-proxy in control ns 3) apply deny-everywhere egress netpol with allowlist to proxy + monitoring 4) roll RBAC via new role/binding 5) enable signed-audit-forwarder.

omar: Netpol snippet I'll use for canary (deny by default egress): ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: egress-allow-kms-proxy
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: ["Egress"]
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: kms-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```

cleo: Audit signing question: will the cluster use ephemeral wrapping keys or customer KMS? If customer KMS, require mTLS and an allowlisted host. If ephemeral, rotate every 7 days and store fingerprint in tenant attest.

deploy-bot: Deploy job started: canary/connectors/v0.9.4 -> kube-canary-3 (job id: DJ-8331).

lina: Also adding egress-anomaly detector: if any pod calls a non-allowlisted host, isolate the pod and page sec-oncall. We'll collect proofs for isolation guarantees.

omar: Rollback plan: unbind provisioner SA from new role, remove netpol, revert connector image, revoke ephemeral keys. Keep runbook steps in playbook.

cleo: I'll add a preflight that scans images for CVEs and enforces SBOM. No image passes -> abort rollout.

lina: Thanks all. Scheduling canary 03:00 UTC. Tagging @omar @cleo for on-call. Please +1 if available.

omar: +1

cleo: +1, will monitor audit signatures and egress logs.
